chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), he said:
I advise you to eat gourds, for they increase in the brain.

key_terms.القَرع: Gourd (a type of vegetable, often referring to pumpkin or squash)

ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of eating gourds according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Imam Ali (a.s.) recommends consuming gourds (*qar'*) for their cognitive benefits, reflecting the Prophetic tradition of utilizing natural foods for physical and mental well-being. This advice underscores the holistic Islamic view of health, where dietary choices are seen as integral to maintaining both bodily strength and intellectual clarity, a theme frequently explored in Shia medical hadiths.
